newsitem.title: USA: FISHER'S WHITE-KNIGHT SEEN ENDING BASS RAID.
newsitem.headline: FISHER'S WHITE-KNIGHT SEEN ENDING BASS RAID.

text.p: The Bass Brothers will likely terminate their hostile, leveraged-buyout bid for Fisher Scientific International Inc after Fisher announced Thursday a friendly $1.4 billion recapitalization merger with Thomas H Lee Co, Wall Street takeover speculators said.
"I think it's over. Ninety-seven percent of Fisher shareholder $51 (per share) and the remaining three percent get 10 percent of the company," said an arbitrageur who declined to be identified.
In early-session trade, Fisher shares were off 1-3/8, or 2.7 percent, to 49-1/2.

"(Fisher) was shopped, and I don't think there were any strategic buyers, they could not find any. There are not that many logical players out there" that would fit with Fisher's specialized business of supplying scientific instruments and products, he said.

"We believe that there were three other financial buyers interested, and the Bass brothers were not one of them. This is a standard recap. We have seen a lot of these lately. Financial buyers are being aggressive out there," said a second arb, who requested anonimity.
